fields.statement: Within the ArgentSea solution's build graph, ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql is the only project declaring explicit BuildDependency edges, on ArgentSea.Orleans and ArgentSea.Sql; the Release BuildType is declared for all five product projects plus ArgentSea.Shared's test project (ArgentSea.Test), and is never declared for the other four test projects (ArgentSea.Orleans.Test, ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.Test, ArgentSea.Pg.Test, ArgentSea.Sql.Test).
fields.scope: Per-project BuildDependency and BuildType declarations in the ArgentSea.slnx solution file.
